state_shape.participants: ordered list of opaque center IDs
state_shape.effects: ordered state changes to participant-local KFS
state_shape.residuals: unresolved distinctions retained without forced closure

relation_to_factors.MUSIC: ordered temporal presentation/traversal of Theater state
relation_to_factors.DEVELOPMENTAL_TIME: past provenance -> now local state -> future return/reopening

claim_fence: A valid TheaterState is a representational target and executable noncollapse scaffold. It is not evidence that raw language has been understood, that the represented World is true, that any participant authorized action, or that general Theater/Music cognition has been learned.
